prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished pixel art sprite sheet for a dark medieval cyber-fantasy sidescrolling game. BOTTOM: repaired rescue shelter, reattached antique metal plates, warm brass edging, three rectangular dark empty passenger bay windows along the middle that game code will illuminate, restrained luminous turquoise conduits and working antenna. Rich detailed pixel artistry matching Kingdom-like woodland ruins, hand-dithered muted steel teal and dark olive with copper highlights, machinery and bolts and scratches and rivets, little weathering moss at base. True SIDE ELEVATION, no perspective floor, no ground, no cast shadow, transparent background. Ship facing right; rounded cockpit right, rear propulsion left, dorsal antenna, 3 evenly spaced passenger windows, wide low body about 2.5 times wider than tall. Cohesive medieval technology, no modern car, no bus, no cartoon. TWO entire ships only, top wreck then bottom restored. Each ship centered within its own half with generous blank padding, not touching. No labels, no text, no people, no scenery, no UI. Sharp discrete pixel clusters, crisp one-pixel material highlights, clear structure, no blur, no glow spill.
